purpose: Run the first controlled two-worker AutoBot shakedown using isolated instances of the proven long-run engine before any larger parallel wave or longer endurance activation.
northStar: Continuously improve Bikeztagram toward a polished, reliable creative editing product while preserving the protected proven builder and truthful verification.

activationGate.operatorControl: Temporary live activation for exactly two isolated instances of the proven AutoBot engine during controlled fifteen- or thirty-minute shakedowns only. Protected integration remains disabled and requires operator-controlled review. Larger waves and longer endurance require separate operator-approved activation changes.

handoffRules: Workers must write structured evidence before handing work to another worker.
Each live worker must receive an explicit isolated work package with no overlapping file scope.
A failure belongs in the failure queue when the current worker cannot safely complete or verify its task.
Repair work must be isolated from the protected builder until independently verified.
No worker may weaken a validator, safety rule, protected workflow or production gate merely to turn a failure into a pass.
Every new bot, entrypoint, path, protocol name and handoff contract must be registered here and covered by the fleet verifier before activation.
The coordinator must never invent a worker, path or protocol that is absent from this registry.
The proven fleet worker must delegate execution to the existing long-run executor rather than introduce a second builder engine.
Successful workers require production verification and publication to an isolated candidate branch before completed-work handoff.
The recovery runner may orchestrate Repair, QA and Reviewer only after the explicit fleet activation gate is enabled.
Only durations listed in activationGate.allowedTestDurations may be used for controlled live shakedowns; larger waves or longer endurance require a separate operator-approved activation change.
